title: Psychedelic
summary: UV blacklight poster look: deep navy darkness with AI-painted art (a space sky with a ringed planet, a moonlit mushroom forest, floating jellyfish, twinkling sparkles) and Poppins Bold lettering with dark navy bodies, a thin neon cyan rim, a second line just inside it and a soft magenta glow. Highlighter yellow marks the one emphasised word. The image model paints the art; code only animates it and draws the letters. Motion is subtle and slow. Extends fashion for its piece set; ships Borumi editor compositions too (borumi/). Spec: STYLE.md.
